description: This Java class extends SimpleWikiHelper to add functionality for fetching random words from Wiktionary and formatting wiki-style text into HTML for display, including handling sections, internal links, and style rules.

classes.name: ExtendedWikiHelper
classes.description: A helper class for processing wiki text and fetching random words from Wiktionary, extending SimpleWikiHelper.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Fetches a random dictionary word from Wiktionary API, retrying up to 3 times to find a valid word.

methods.name: formatWikiText
methods.description: Converts wiki-style markup text into styled HTML suitable for WebView display, filtering sections and applying formatting rules.
